1934, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO, 5.
Page 258
Oct. 31 11 a.m. Lawrence Burns - about 65 in Rec. Hospit. - Complica- tion, ulcer in stomach, imp'ema - very peculiar, one of only 4 cases in U. S. Enrolled Today .... 1:40 P.M. reported " ... siting up when card was brought to him in hospital." Nov. 1 same Burns went home to his family.
Pauline Ryan - 27 - of Hardensburg, Ky. - sinus
Lloyd Walker - 16 - no religion but kindly disposed people - dan- ger from explosion of losing eyes.
Ed. Kineman - 22 - missing two years except one letter last Febr.
Mrs. Mary Sherman - (60) - shaving - 20 yrs. - anxious to be re- lieved of this cross.
Page 259 Page 260
Blank Page
1934, November
Nov. 3 Clifford Jon. Lorchner - 25 - postponed marriage - now the other party estranged ... mother distracted lest she be to blame .....
Mrs. Rosetta Ballini - 32 - married over ten yrs. Praying all time for blessing of children. Enrolled To-day for that Int. promising daily Communion instead of twice monthly - for at least three months.
Mother Mary of Our Lady of Wisdom - 35 - ( ?)
Edw'd Donald A. Herman - 7 (10) nerv. - bowel, colds ....
Mrs. Catherine Larean - 32 - T. B. recovering - nervous for home and little girls ....
Mrs. Anna Currie - 34 - husband & 2 - very nervous.
Virginia Comando - 29 - goiter, sinus, nervous-break-down, etc. Doctors -hopeless.
Blank Page
Page 261 Page 262 Nov. 7 James Gleeson - 15 - spinal maningitis & Scarlet fever - five yrs. ago - never get entirely well - broken apendix ... now taking fear- ful Convulsions - Dr's puzzled ... Enrolled 50c
